sn43.11:1.1: … “And what, bhikkhus, is the path leading to the unconditioned?
sn43.11:1.3: this is called the path leading to the unconditioned.
sn43.11:1.4: “Thus, bhikkhus, I have taught you the unconditioned and the path leading to the unconditioned….
sn43.11:1.6: This is our instruction to you.”
